0.1.29.37 (Android test candidate; not released)
- Legacy profiles remain internal; explicit per-profile artwork choices and safe fresh-profile gate.
- Player exit: release live overlay before queued Stop; bounded checkpoint and single-flight background native Stop with timeout diagnostics. Device root cause remains unverified.
- Artwork: dynamic Kodi URLs for visible items, persistent internal or explicit USB/SD/Kodi-SMB target. Existing profiles remain internal; only positively fresh profiles default dynamic. Kodi texture cache remains untouched.
- Verified per-profile external copy with inventory, SHA256, restart/pause journal, render confirmation and separate activation/optional original cleanup. Offline targets never silently switch back or reset READY jobs.
- Storage management now includes cover-download pause/resume, explicit preloading and optional adaptive reserve; metadata/SQLite remain internal.
- Wizard: owner-safe Save/Home handoff, data-only worker callbacks, visible activity from EPG source 1/N, original branding, and selected Xtream group delta indexing.
- Diagnostics: measured device/RAM/firmware/API/filesystem values; smaller installed-profile Home entry preserves autoplay/navigation.
src/plugin.video.xtreammate/changelog.tx.new:
0.1.29.38 (cumulative Android test candidate; not released)
- Startup: saved portal preference governs explicit foreground root/Home/app_open entry. Session intent deduplicates refreshes and resolver calls; background widgets/foreign playback do not start TV. Historical diagnostic default is replaced by an explicit 15-minute pause action; no portal setting is reset.
- Dynamic artwork: proactive DNS-bounded revalidation, no expired URI admission to new rows, retain already displayed textures only while their exact source is pending. Definitive failures show placeholders. Repaint only changed artwork; no new archive jobs or texture-cache reset.
- Live: exact five-level Left chain through mini guide, groups, compact and expanded full-height rails back to running full-screen video. Shared local MIT Tabler icons, real focus and context routes. Mini guide always shows marked channel's real previous/current/future programmes on the right; Right moves focus without tuning.
- Shared rail: media landing/category edge and guide group edge, plus an explicit Home context action. Global three-tab search excluded. New routes dispatch after owner/modal release; Home stops owned playback explicitly.
- Player: actual Kodi capability-gated transport with local Tabler icons. Live retains first-OK info and second-OK/Down controls, direct large-guide action and native audio/picture/subtitle settings. VOD adds supported skips/FF/RW, remaining time and asynchronous Stop; Back closes the OSD. No decoder/keymap replacement, no autoplay pipeline rewrite.
- Storage: localized physical archive/job/free-space diagnosis; separate optional developer data. Optional Dynamic-mode internal-image cleanup requires complete read-only inventory and double confirmation, exact owned hashes/roots, journal/resume and selected READY reconciliation. Kodi textures and all other profile data remain protected.
- SQLite: distinguish busy, query time budget, schema and corruption without rebuild/reset; guard native focus 300 including detail-menu visibility edges.
- Existing .37 profiles/artwork modes, original icon/assets, portals, EPG/mappings, groups, favourites, resume and autoplay retained. All new Android gates NOT_TESTED; Box B no further storage/migration tests; Box A only read-only preflight then separately authorized actions.
- Three OSD design diagrams supplied, not approved screenshots. Home rail is an explicit context action rather than a permanently embedded Kodi-directory rail; cross-section scroll restoration still needs separate Android acceptance. Physical metadata offload and durable uncommitted Wizard-scan resume remain inherited BLOCKED work. Central EPG Hub stays separate. No merge/release/automatic install.

                      ('no such column','SCHEMA_ERROR'),('no such table','SCHEMA_ERROR')):
